candidates.scenario: One nonce-owned Script and Script Task on Native3, retry=2, no schedule. Declare one required non-secret string Task parameter qa_value; UI Run supplies the fixed QA nonce. Payload reads only NODESTEER_PARAM_qa_value, validates the expected value without printing it, and emits only its length and SHA-256 in each stream marker. A readonly verifier first checks fresh Native3 Agent owner/Unit/proc+disk SHA=d55, python3 availability, and fixed marker path absence. The immutable payload creates its marker with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW and emits tagged stdout/stderr chunks containing true attempt-start monotonic_ns; attempts 1–2 fail, attempt 3 succeeds and unlinks only the same guarded inode. One actual UI Run click.
oracle: Before fixture creation, verifier confirms exact Node/Agent API identity and health (outer API guard), Native3 agent ancestor UID/Unit/config-argv-path/proc-exe+disk SHA and marker path absent; verifier emits only IDs, PID/startticks, hashes and booleans.

UI Task Run presents the required qa_value input. Exactly one click supplies the non-secret fixed QA nonce; Agent reads only NODESTEER_PARAM_qa_value, validates exact expected value, and prints only parameter length/SHA plus a QA match marker, never the raw parameter or environment.

One UI click yields exactly one manual Execution ID and one logical execute audit action; three distinct attempt markers under that ID. Actual attempt start times come from monotonic_ns embedded in payload output.
GET Logs preserves stdout/stderr stream tags, sequence/cardinality, and each 70KiB chunk BEGIN/END markers; final Execution is SUCCESS and UI/API agree.

Marker create/update/remove guards require exact regular file, euid/egid, mode0600, nlink1, nonce-bound content, O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW on creation, and same dev/inode before overwrite/unlink. Any collision/symlink/foreign state is refused without mutation.

Verifier runs twice (pre/post). If postcheck reports the exact marker still present, stop and preserve it; optional exact-cleanup Task/Run is only used after separate Root review and only for nonce-bound marker identity. Do not delete an unknown path.
Record monotonic gaps; do not assert a configured retry delay unless the canonical/product contract defines one. Without such a delay contract, that timing subdimension remains PARTIAL.

FL-05 gains required-parameter input/environment evidence for this Script Task only. It remains PARTIAL unless the same Execution has verified Task/Script/Node backlinks and stdout/stderr/status UI feedback.
candidates.cleanup: After one terminal SUCCESS, verifier postcheck must prove marker absent. Exact-delete verifier Task, Script Task and Script; preserve Execution/Audit. If marker remains, halt and retain it. A single contingency exact-cleanup Task/Run is budgeted but not automatic: it requires a later Root-approved source and must refuse any path/inode/owner/mode/content mismatch; preserve unknown files.
